album.title: Radif Navazi - Tar: Dashti, Bayat Kord

just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on F5 and dwells most on Bb in Gharaei. The line peaks at D5 (561.6 Hz) at 1:23.9. It closes on F3, not the tonic (Ak4 → Ak4 → G4 → G4 → G4 → F3).
